name: 13k-2026-unicorns-and-rainbows
description: js13kGames 2026 entry — theme: Unicorns and Rainbows

scripts.build-js13k: vite build -m js13k && node scripts/inline.js && npm run package -- --track
scripts.build-js13k-roadroller: vite build -m js13k && node scripts/inline.js && node scripts/roadroll.js && npm run package -- --track
scripts.build-poki: vite build -m poki && npm run package
scripts.bot: vite build -m bot --ssr scripts/bot-harness.ts --outDir dist-bot --emptyOutDir --logLevel error && node dist-bot/bot.js
scripts.sweep: vite build -m bot --ssr scripts/sweep-harness.ts --outDir dist-bot --emptyOutDir --logLevel error && node dist-bot/bot.js
scripts.levels: vite build -m bot --ssr scripts/level-harness.ts --outDir dist-bot --emptyOutDir --logLevel error && node dist-bot/bot.js
